title: Non-Academic Staff Survey Questionnaire
purpose: This survey collects feedback for the Self-Assessment Report of the Mass Communication and Journalism Discipline. Your responses help improve teaching, facilities, and graduate outcomes.
confidentiality: This survey is strictly anonymous. Data will be aggregated for quality assurance purposes only. No individual will be identified in the reporting.
scale: 1 = Strongly Disagree / Very Poor | 2 = Disagree / Poor | 3 = Neutral / Average | 4 = Agree / Good | 5 = Strongly Agree / Excellent

questions.text: Recruitment: The recruitment process for my position was transparent, fair, and merit-based.
Job Description: My roles and responsibilities are clearly defined and communicated to me.
Code of Conduct: I am fully aware of the Code of Conduct and ethical guidelines for staff.
Orientation: I received a proper orientation/induction when I joined the department/institution.
Training: The institution provides adequate training and workshops to upgrade my professional skills.
Performance Evaluation: My performance is evaluated regularly based on clear Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Feedback: I receive constructive feedback from my supervisors to help me improve my work.
Promotion/Incentives: There are opportunities for promotion or incentives based on my performance.
Salary: The salary structure and benefits are satisfactory and competitive.
Workload: My workload is reasonable and distributed fairly.
Office Space: I have adequate office space and a suitable workstation to perform my duties.
Equipment: I have access to necessary equipment (computers, internet, printers) to do my job effectively.
Safety: The workplace is safe, secure, and hygienic (including washrooms, prayer rooms, canteen).
Technology: The software or IT tools (e.g., student database, library software) I use are up-to-date and functional.
Vision/Mission: I am aware of the Vision and Mission of the institution/department.
Leadership: The management is approachable and responsive to staff needs.
Grievance Redressal: There is an effective mechanism to address staff grievances or complaints.
Respect: I am treated with respect and dignity by faculty members and students.
Harassment Policy: I am aware of the policy regarding sexual harassment and know how to report issues.
